title: Yummy Venezuelan Zucchini Casserole
description: A jammy, bouncy casserole that brings a lazy Sunday comfort to the table with a sweet maple glaze and fresh herbs.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add sliced zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to wilt, about 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato sauce and oregano, season with salt and pepper, and let the mixture simmer for 3 minutes.
Transfer the zucchini mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Drizzle maple syrup over the top and sprinkle chopped basil.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake an additional 10 minutes, or until the zucchini is tender and the glaze is slightly caramelized.
Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm as a side or main dish.
